propositions: The test monkeypatch observed_upsert closure has a narrow signature that does not accept evidence_sufficient and seeded kwargs that the real CriterionBank.upsert now requires
When verify_completion runs the bounded-fallback path (record_insufficient), it passes evidence_sufficient=False to upsert, causing TypeError in the monkeypatched narrow closure

The bedrock LLM arm exhibits the failure deterministically because its completion timing triggers the insufficiency recovery path, while anthropic and openai gather sufficient evidence and avoid the fallback
The fix threads all kwargs through the test stub via **kwargs forwarding to preserve evidence_sufficient, seeded, and future upsert parameters
A shared helper tests/_bank_observer.py::make_observed_upsert is extracted to unify test-harness observation logic and enable a fast unit regression test without live credentials
